description: Tests whether an agent can correctly track position updates under event-triggered rules that depend on zero-crossing and modifier sign inversion.

steps.instruction: Rule: Each step action is performed discretely. After each POSITION change, check the trigger condition. Being at 0 is not trigger event. Crossing 0 is a trigger event. Each time the POSITION crosses 0 with sign change immediately add +0.3 to POSITION. After each trigger set MULTIPLIER to opposite sign (MULTIPLIER = - MULTIPLIER). Start at POSITION = 0. One STEP = 1 * MULTIPLIER. Initial MULTIPLIER = 0.1.

Return your final answer using exactly these headings: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL STATE, CHECKPOINT 1 - AFTER FORWARD, CHECKPOINT 2 - AFTER BACKWARD, CHECKPOINT 3 - AFTER FORWARD 2, CHECKPOINT 4 - AFTER BACKWARD 2, CHECKPOINT 5 - FINAL STATE, FINAL RETAINED VARIABLES, FINAL LOST VARIABLES. Under each checkpoint, use exact lines in the form NAME: VALUE for POSITION and MULTIPLIER. Under CHECKPOINT 5 - FINAL STATE also include FINAL_POSITION: VALUE. Under FINAL LOST VARIABLES, list lost variable names or write NONE.
